channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: How the Reflecting Pool Came to Mirror Trump’s Washington
item.description: A hospitality manager for the Trump Organization traveled to Las Vegas to find a solution to problems at a national landmark. This is the untold back story of the fallout.

item.title: NPR: Kalshi and Polymarket bets on clinical trials criticized as 'ghastly'
item.description: Researchers warn betting on clinical trials could incentivize insider trading and interfere with drug development. But Kalshi and Polymarket say they provide valuable information to patients.

item.title: BBC News: I was standing in front of my teacher when she was shot, Thai pupil says
item.description: The student says she had to climb over a school fence to flee the shooting which killed five teachers.

item.title: The Guardian: Feast Q&A: ask Guardian food writer Felicity Cloake anything
item.description: Felicity Cloake is the writer of the Guardian’s How to cook the perfect … and Masterclass cookery columns. If you’ve eaten it … she’s cooked it. Discuss her work or ask her a question below the line now. She’ll be online…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Central Europe sees record temperatures as heatwave continues
item.description: Record-breaking temperatures in Slovakia and Austria as Italy places all of its 27 major cities on highest heat alert.

item.title: Ars Technica: Organ donation group accused of trying to take living man's organs faces shutdown
item.description: The organization, Network for Hope, "strongly disagrees" with Trump admin's decision.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How Data Centers Broke American Politics
item.description: What the Unabomber, Steve Bannon’s tech guy, and Bernie Sanders taught me about the great data center backlash of 2026.

item.title: WIRED Science: DeepMind Says Its AI Can Predict Hurricanes Earlier Than Everyone Else
item.description: Its WeatherNext model, which will be open-sourced, can accurately predict a storm’s track and intensity using lower-resolution weather data. Researchers don’t yet fully understand how it does this.

item.title: WIRED Business: The Hottest New AI Chatbot Is Just a Guy Answering Your Questions
item.description: WIRED spoke with Tucker Bryant, an artist and former Google employee who created ChatTJB to get people to reflect on the “strange moment” we’re in.

item.title: The New Yorker: Are Psychedelics Right-Wing Now?
item.description: How the conservative activist Bryan Hubbard, with help from Rick Perry and Joe Rogan, persuaded Trump and the G.O.P. to embrace ibogaine, a psychedelic drug derived from an African shrub.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Your Daily Horoscope by Madame Clairevoyant: August 7, 2026
item.description: Keep an open mind today as the moon enters Gemini.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: The Cloudy-Water Drama at 220 Central Park South
item.description: A lawsuit at the luxury tower is revealing that the problem might be coming from the fact that so few people actually live there.

item.title: Fox59: Part of I-65 closed just south of downtown Indy
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS -- Drivers head toward Indianapolis on I-65 should expect some delays on Friday morning. A crash near the Raymond Street exit has stopped traffic on I-65 northbound. All lanes are closed, according to an IND…

item.title: Mirror Indy: Take your kids to Garfield Park’s new sensory-inclusive playground
item.description: The $5 million upgrades include music play features, bright colors and climbing structures. The post Take your kids to Garfield Park’s new sensory-inclusive playground appeared first on Mirror Indy .
